record.title: Deploy the pinned derived native sidecar and verify normal startup
record.intent: Select the D capability record while retaining the original signed application and public identity.
requirements: Require accepted ordinary-option reboot persistence and current preserved baseline. Derive the actual package native library directory from current metadata and require the target sidecar absent.

Under fresh isolated capture install only the derived native ELF SHA256 09689a442e8d285775b37089a8d631e1e445fe03d3499e830cdcc8f32439504e using verified temporary-file transfer and atomic rename with system ownership and0644 mode; preserve the stock signed APK byte-for-byte.
Send only one normal reboot request; preserve a transport timeout without retransmission and continue the bounded observation for a fresh lease and changed boot.

Require new boot identity, normal full Sparrow UI, unchanged public identity, all ten ordinary statuses with BND false, exact license/key persistence, actual standalone native mapping/hash and repeated cached18/18 using the accepted16-byte observer.

Preserve calibration payloads and all other captured logical data; allow only the already explained bandwidth-record header timestamp/checksum rewrite and startup identity-fallback cache, recording their exact deltas. Unexpected changes require reconciliation before acceptance.

On loading or startup failure preserve evidence and remove only the introduced sidecar before a normal recovery reboot; verify original APK-backed loading and restored17/17. No calibration, reset, firmware replacement or unrelated configuration change.
acceptance: The first physical D startup is accepted or the failed transition and bounded rollback are preserved.
